Read the given statements and conclusions carefully Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements :**

All blue are dogs.

No dog is silver

All pink are dogs.

**Conclusions : **

(I) Some pink are silver.

(II) No blue is pink is a possibility.

(III) Some blue are silver

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follow
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc61d416a5142f2e1714a356015da5951345bfd3660949c149fe27ff6dad4742.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some pink are silver → **Does not** Follow (As, all pink are dogs and no dog is silver, So, no pink will be silver, therefore Some pink are silver will be definitely false)

II. No blue is pink is a possibility → Follow (As, all blue are dogs and all pink are dogs. and, no definite relation is given between blue and pink, so No blue is pink can be possible therefore it is definitely true)

III. Some blue are silver → Does not Follow (As, all blue are dogs and no dog is silver. So, no blue will be silver, therefore Some blue are silver is definitely false)

Here, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusion II follows**".

questions.question: The rate at which the Reserve Bank of India lends to other commercial banks for short term has been reduced. What is this rate called?

• It is the rate at which the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) lends money to commercial banks for short term.
 
• The reduction in Repo Rate indicates that the RBI is trying to encourage borrowing and spending in the economy. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• CRR is the amount of funds that banks have to keep with the RBI as a reserve. It is not related to lending rates.
 
 
 
• **Reverse Repo Rate:-**
 
 
• It is the rate at which the RBI borrows money from commercial banks. It is also not related to lending rates.
 
 
 
• **Bank Rate:-**
 
 
• It is the rate at which the RBI lends money to commercial banks for long term. It is also not related to short-term lending rates.
